main_subject.description: An adult woman with long center-parted dark waves, minimal makeup, and black angular sunglasses.
main_subject.wardrobe: A plain black crew-neck T-shirt, high-waisted wide-leg blue-gray jeans without rips, plain white sneakers, and a small glossy white unbranded shoulder bag.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Standing on a clearly closed pedestrian crossing at night with relaxed shoulders and a confident forward gaze.

composition_elements.setting: Empty city road with zebra lines, abstract distant lamps, and a clearly visible pedestrian-only traffic closure barrier.
composition_elements.framing: Slightly elevated eye-level medium-full portrait with shallow depth of field.
composition_elements.text_and_brand_control: No uploaded-face preservation, logo, designer bag monogram, shoe branding, road sign text, or readable markings.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Warm streetlights with cinematic highlights and soft controlled shadows.
lighting_and_atmosphere.mood: Calm, urban, confident, and safely staged.

technical_specs.rendering: Natural skin and anatomy, sharp subject, soft background bokeh, clean road texture, no beautification.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical photoreal cinematic street editorial portrait of an adult woman with long center-parted dark waves, minimal makeup, and black angular sunglasses. She wears a plain black crew-neck T-shirt, high-waisted wide-leg blue-gray jeans without rips, plain white sneakers, and a small glossy white unbranded shoulder bag. Place her standing on a clearly closed pedestrian crossing at night, with relaxed shoulders and a confident forward gaze. Show zebra lines, abstract distant lamps, and a visible pedestrian-only traffic closure barrier. Use slightly elevated eye-level medium-full framing, warm streetlights, cinematic highlights, soft controlled shadows, natural skin and anatomy, sharp subject, soft background bokeh, and clean road texture. No uploaded-face preservation, logos, monograms, shoe branding, road-sign text, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, crop top, ripped jeans, lingerie, sitting in traffic, unsafe road pose, logo, monogram, readable text, watermark, distorted hands, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Only optional adult identity references may guide general approved traits. Replaceable wardrobe and streetscape references must remove brand marks, text, and unsafe traffic context.
